Warranty on Repair and Spare Parts The service provider shall provide a minimum warranty of 90 days on repair workmanship a nd 180 days on replaced spare parts, or such other period as specified in the bid. Time Limit for Repair The service provider shall complete the repair within the period specified in the tender/work order.
